description: This file contains the implementation of generic and specific producer grains for Orleans streams, including classes for producing items of type T, int, and Apple, along with the Apple class definition.

classes.name: TypedProducerGrain<T>
classes.description: A generic Orleans grain that produces stream items of type T, managing periodic production and exception handling.

classes.name: TypedProducerGrainProducingInt
classes.description: A specialized grain for producing integer stream items.

classes.name: TypedProducerGrainProducingApple
classes.description: A specialized grain for producing Apple stream items.

classes.name: Apple
classes.description: A simple class representing an Apple with a numeric identifier, implementing IFruit.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Configures the grain to produce to a specific stream.

methods.name: StartPeriodicProducing
methods.description: Starts a timer to produce items periodically.

methods.name: StopPeriodicProducing
methods.description: Stops the periodic production timer and throws if there were exceptions.

methods.name: GetNumberProduced
methods.description: Returns the number of items produced so far.

methods.name: ClearNumberProduced
methods.description: Resets the count of produced items.

methods.name: Produce
methods.description: Triggers production of a single item.

methods.name: TimerCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked by the timer to produce an item.

methods.name: ProducerOnNextAsync
methods.description: Produces an item to the stream, handling exceptions.

methods.name: Fire
methods.description: Increments the count and produces an item, logging the action.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the grain is deactivated.

methods.name: ProducerOnNextAsync (overridden in specialized grains)
methods.description: Produces specific types of items (int or Apple) to the stream.

methods.name: Apple
methods.description: Represents an Apple with a unique number, serializable for Orleans streams.
